# The status checks main requires before a merge: the set under
# Settings > Branches > main > "Require status checks to pass", one
# context name per line. Each name is a job id in
# .github/workflows/check.yml, and a line starting with # is a comment.
#
# This file exists because that setting lives outside the tree, where no
# diff shows it changing. The "Audit main's required status checks" step
# in check.yml's check job reads the live set through the API and fails
# when it differs from this file, or when a name here is not a job in
# that workflow. Adding a check to the required set, dropping one, or
# renaming a required job therefore takes a commit that shows the change.
# https://github.com/c4milo/chapulin/issues/91
#
# To change the set, edit Settings and this file in one change. Auto-merge
# (.github/workflows/dependabot-automerge.yml) waits on exactly these
# checks, and GitHub refuses to enable it on a branch that requires none,
# so this list is never empty.
check
arm64
m3
freertos
riscv32
mips
san
coverage
